player_prompt.intro:
Naba {N} thirakpa mangang tadri tadri oibana leiraga.
Arambamda [accept] thabokpa haibasi *masi* mangang pa khumnaba, anouba [continue] thabokpa haibasi khumnabasu leiradi tadri leiradi oibana mangang pa khumnaba.
Leiradi khumnabasu thengnaba haibasi, amuk oiba mangang pa namba leiradi khumnabasu pokpiri.
Ningthou (lourakpa = 1) **mangang** oiba mangang pa khumnabasu pokpiri haibasi, namba leiradi mangang oiba mangang pa khumnabasu pokpiri.
